claims.evidence: Witness report says box text reads “D3300” and “18-55 VR II Kit” and “BLACK” (Photo 0 and Photo 1).
Witness report does not show sensor specs on the photos; only box/model text is reported.
Witness report does not show any performance/specs evidence in the photos.
Witness report does not show AF-point/3D tracking evidence in the photos.

risks.risk: Unclear functional condition (shutter count, sensor health, autofocus accuracy, buttons/dials working).
risks.proof: A short video/clip showing: power on, live view, autofocus on a moving subject, and a quick shutter test (multiple shots) plus a screen showing any shutter count/diagnostic if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: not fully tested/unknown working condition.

risks.risk: Lens glass condition unknown (scratches, fungus, haze, separation) and mount wear.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lens elements (front and rear) under bright light/flash, plus a photo of the lens mount and any visible wear.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: lens may have defects (treat as needing discount for possible haze/fungus/scratches).

risks.risk: Accessories may be incomplete (battery, charger, cables, caps, strap, manuals, warranty card).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of every included item with a checklist (battery model, charger, caps, strap, USB cable, manuals, SD card if any).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: missing some accessories (no SD card/unknown completeness).

risks.proof: A clip showing battery level after a few minutes of use (live view + a few shots) and/or a battery health indicator if the camera shows it.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: battery may be weak and may require replacement.

risks.risk: Damage/repairs not visible from the box-only view (drops, water exposure, missing parts).
risks.proof: Photos of the camera body from all sides including corners/hinges/ports, plus a close-up of the hot shoe and any seams for cracks or dents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: possible cosmetic/structural wear not yet confirmed.

risks.risk: Storage media/firmware status unknown (SD card not shown; firmware may be outdated).
risks.proof: Photo of the SD card slot with an inserted SD card (if included) and a screen showing firmware version (camera “About” page).
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: no SD card and firmware not confirmed.

proof_requests: Show a video of the camera powering on, autofocus working (on a moving subject), and taking a short burst.
Provide close-up photos of lens front and rear glass under bright light/flash, and a photo of the lens mount.
Lay out and photograph all included accessories (battery, charger, caps, strap, cables, manuals/warranty) and confirm completeness.
Show battery condition in use (battery level after live view + a few shots) or any battery health indicator.
Photograph camera body corners/ports/hot shoe for cracks/dents/water damage; include a view of the sensor area if possible.
Confirm whether an SD card is included and show firmware version from the camera menu.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item as a Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II Kit (black) from box text, so it can be priced at worst-case for unverified condition and missing accessories.
